# Responsive Layout UI Skill

## When to use
- Fix mobile stacking, spacing, or overlapping sections
- Adjust nav behavior for smaller screens
- Improve card layouts, buttons, and contact CTA responsiveness
- Tune breakpoints or layout density for different viewport widths

## Workflow
1. Inspect the relevant section in `index.html` plus the matching responsive rules in `assets/css/responsive.css`.
2. Keep the layout mobile-first and add constraints only where needed.
3. Preserve the premium look while improving readability and tap targets.
4. Check hero content, service grids, and contact sections across common sizes.
5. Prefer controlled spacing and stable alignment over fragile adjustments.
6. Validate that core conversion goals remain obvious on small screens.

## Relevant files
- `index.html`
- `assets/css/responsive.css`
- `assets/css/sections.css`
- `assets/css/components.css`
- `assets/css/style.css`

## Quality bar
- Layout remains polished and stable at every major breakpoint.
- Content flows clearly and is easy to scan on mobile devices.
- The sales-focused experience remains strong on all screen sizes.
